overall_assessment: When UiB has a plan, extraction is complete and clean: all eight random controls hold the full plan with every section and no navigation, and the year picker and contact lines are correctly left out. The weakness is offerings whose page has no plan: all 20 suspects are stubs that hold only the facts box plus a dangling 'Emnebeskrivelse' heading, so they look like real records but contain no plan text. Three of the four fetch failures (400, 404, 502) look transient or plausible, and I could not judge the fourth.

findings.evidence:
Inga emnebeskriving tilgjengeleg
Det finst inga emnebeskriving. Grunnen kan vere at emnebeskrivinga ikkje er omsett eller at semesteret du har valt framleis ikkje har emnebeskriving.
findings.description: The page was fetched (HTTP 200) but the site says no course description exists for the chosen semester. The extracted text is only the facts box (title, level, credits, teaching semester, code) ending in the bare heading 'Emnebeskrivelse', 80 offerings by the short flag and all 20 suspects here. These rows are counted as 'fetched with extracted text' but hold no plan content. The page also shows 'Feil i visning av emnebeskrivelse' error banners on some, so some may be a transient site failure rather than a missing plan.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The selector div.region-inner.grid captures the facts box even when the description block is absent. The 'no description' notice and the error banners lie outside the selector, so nothing marks these pages as empty. The pre-pass 'empty' flag is 0 because the text is not blank.
findings.suggested_fix: In the UiB config or the extract_fulltext post step, treat a text with no 'Mål og innhold' or 'Læringsutbytte' section (text ends at 'Emnebeskrivelse') as empty, or detect the page notice 'Inga emnebeskriving tilgjengeleg' in the html, so the offering counts as having no plan (target gaps). Re-fetch the pages that show 'Feil i visning av emnebeskrivelse' to rule out a transient error.

findings.description: The exam block (assessment type, submission deadline, duration, exam dates) is on the page but outside the extracted text. The plan's own 'Vurderingsformer' text is captured, so only logistics are lost. This is probably out of scope under the plan spec (exam logistics, not plan text), and it is reported for completeness.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The exam-information widget sits outside div.region-inner.grid or loads separately.
findings.suggested_fix: No change needed if exam dates count as logistics. If the assessment form (for example 'Skriftleg skoleeksamen', 'Mappevurdering', 'Varigheit 3 timar') is wanted as metadata, add the exam-info container as a second selector.
